# PySR

> High-Performance Symbolic Regression in Python and Julia

Coding agents should read the PySR agent skill before writing PySR code: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astroautomata/PySR/master/skills/pysr/SKILL.md. Install it with `npx skills add astroautomata/PySR`.
